activities.title: Hardware, software or peopleware?
activities.intro: Sort the 9 items below. Put each one in the right group: hardware, software or peopleware.

blocks.prompt: Sort each item into the right group.
items: The client filling out a form online

help: Is it a physical device or part? Then it is hardware.
Programs and instructions that run on the device, like Windows or an app, are software.
People who use, run or support the system are peopleware.

activities.title: Quick check: the Windows update
activities.intro: One question. Pick the best answer.

blocks.prompt: Your PC feels slow, so the ICT focal person installs a Windows update. What part of the system did they update?
